capabilities: Transcribe microphone input and vault audio files
Create Markdown transcripts with source links
Generate AI analyses from configurable templates
extras: Sends audio and transcript text to configured external providers; Echo Memory is marked experimental; local service commands run verbatim under the user account.
intentEvidence: In offline mode, enable or disable Obsidian's core Audio recorder and save hotkeys for its commands.
motivation: The author wanted recordings, transcripts, and analyses to become linked personal knowledge and long-term context for a personal AI, not isolated meeting output.
problem: Meeting audio, transcripts, and AI notes often stay in separate tools and are not linked back into the Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: Obsidian's Audio recorder core plugin is used only by the offline workflow
Ollama through its local OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint
LM Studio through its local OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint

requires.name: Cloud transcription or AI analysis provider

summary: Audio transcription and AI meeting-note plugin that creates Markdown transcripts, template-based analyses, and memory profiles.
